correctness.rationale: The integrated feature kernel is as stated and canonical because E[H_t(U)]=0; its mean diagonal is ∫u(2u−1)²du−1/30=2/15. In the cube of the centered kernel expansion, a lone diagonal at an independent vertex vanishes by centering, and an unmarked vertex appearing in only one pair term vanishes by conditional degeneracy. The surviving triple diagonal, two diagonals on a pair, diagonal with doubled pair, tripled pair, and triangle have coefficients n, 12 binom(n,2), 24 binom(n,2), 8 binom(n,2), and 48 binom(n,3). Independent exact-rational integration reproduces the five contractions 86677/13513500, 15931/11583000, 280583/121621500, 225809/162162000, and 502883/324324000 in order; the two variance contractions are 169/8100 and 109/8100. Coefficient comparison after expanding the binomial counts gives the stated all-size cumulant, not just agreement at sampled sizes. Substitution and differentiation give γ′(x) with sign opposite to P(x)=149806549x²−355004333x+20427855, where P(3)=303673797, P′(3)=543834961 and P″=299613098. Skewness is positive at every integer n≥1; exact squared comparisons give γ₂>γ₁, and γ₂²−γ₃²=14038148030846784406/158775012314273730375>0. Therefore the sequence decreases strictly from n=2, has its unique integer maximum there, and stays above its limit for every n≥2. The asymptotic limit and the reported small-sample figures are consistent with the formulas.
